Inspect initial values or extract starts from posterior samples

magCompStarting.Rd

Returns a starting-value list organized by component, block, and term, as in magCompSettings. Pass it to magComp(starting = ). Extracting posterior values initializes a new run; it does not resume RNG state or Metropolis adaptation from an earlier run.

Usage

magCompStarting(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'magComp'
magCompStarting(object,
  use = c("initial", "last", "mean"), chain = 1, ...)

Arguments

object

A prepared or fitted magComp model.

use

"initial" returns the resolved values used to initialize the model. "last" extracts the selected chain's last retained draw; "mean" extracts posterior means across all retained chains. The latter two choices require a fitted model.

chain

Chain index for use = "last".

...

Currently unused.

Details

Resolved model settings, starting values, and extracted samples contain only active components. Supplied starting values or nondefault priors for a disabled component are rejected by magComp().

Estimated covariance-parameter starts must lie strictly between their uniform-prior bounds because their Metropolis proposals use a bounded-logit transformation. Starting values have the following structure:


list(
  magnitude = list(
    coefficients = named_vector,
    size = positive_scalar,  # only when size is estimated
    terms = list(term_name = list(
      effects = named_vector, variance = positive_scalar,
      covariance = list(phi = value)  # spatial/space-time terms
    ))
  ),
  composition = list(blocks = list(block_name = list(
    coefficients = named_matrix,
    terms = list(term_name = list(
      loadings = named_matrix, scores = named_matrix,
      covariance = list(phi = value)  # one value per factor
    ))
  )))
)

Only the entries a user wants to override need to be supplied. Omitted entries receive automatic starts. Obtain the correct term names, dimensions, and dimnames from a prepared model via magCompSettings(model)$starting. Use name = "stand" inside a formula term to give it a stable name.

Coefficient matrices have one row per coefficient stick and one column per fixed-effect design column. Loading matrices have coefficient-stick rows and factor columns; score matrices have group/location rows and factor columns. Named inputs are matched to model names, including reordered vectors and matrix rows/columns. Unnamed inputs must follow the template's order. Inputs for coefficients, effects, scores, and loadings must have exactly the required dimensions and finite values; scalar recycling is not performed for these arrays. Loading starts must have positive values on the anchor diagonal and zeros above it. Supplied valid loading and score starts are preserved.

Automatic factor starts use residuals from regressions of transformed empirical continuation ratios. Conditional child blocks have separate regressions for each parent. Terms are initialized sequentially, with iid terms before spatial terms and formula order within each group. Each term's contribution is removed before initializing the next term by SVD.

Automatic loadings and scores are rotated and scaled to satisfy the anchor constraints and give score columns unit mean square. This is an initialization convention, not a constraint on sampled scores. Valid user-supplied loadings or scores are preserved; an omitted matrix is initialized automatically. The technical guide's Data preparation, aggregation, and initialization section gives the details; see magComp-package.

Magnitude iid/spatial variance starts use the variance of initialized effects, bounded below by 1e-4, with a fallback of one if nonpositive or undefined. Covariance starts have automatic coordinate-based defaults. Estimated values must lie strictly inside their uniform-prior supports. To fix a covariance parameter, wrap its starting value in fixed(), for example covariance = list(phi = fixed(2)). Fixed markers are preserved when extracting starts from a fitted model. Common scalars apply to all factors; named vectors or lists specify individual factors. See magCompCovModels.

Value

A named list with magnitude and composition branches. Initial templates contain all fitted model parameter blocks, including fixed covariance values. Extracted starts require the same model structure and group/location labels in the next fit.

See also

magCompNotation for the symbols corresponding to each entry; samples for all retained draws in matching branches.
